performance_limits: One matched run per version; timings include profiling overhead and normal measurement variation.
Engine logic, order hooks, DAT and mod timing categories overlap; do not add them.
DAT prepare/restore costs estimated from one in 64 calls.
Render time per simulation frame includes multiple render calls; it is not rendered FPS or GPU utilization.
Blocked-wave dispatch benchmark uses production code with a host engine adapter; this exact congested-wave timing was not reproduced in a live campaign.

Dedicated map uses mixed Marines, Zealots and Dragoons and selected talents/curses; not every mission or ability combination. A separate private sampling run identified rank lookup as a major hotspot; its timings are not used in this comparison.
Pathfinding hook was measured on this map; Protoss 8 southern choke was not revalidated in the native engine.

diagnosis.method: Private diagnostic DLL samples only its own simulation thread while StepGameLogic is active. No allocations/logging/locks while suspended; immediately resumed.
